scope: Exact multi-View canonical KV cache, full autoregressive synthetic decode simulation (not a trained LM), cache-provenance and allocation audit
source_baselines: local follow-up /mnt/data/ma1164_kv_mirror_20261018/source/kv_benchmark.py (not assumed committed; import into experiment only after adding tested copy to repository)

backend.hardware: 5-vCPU virtual AMD EPYC; no GPU currently
backend.kernel: PyTorch eager CPU reference, later fused as separate arm

execution_budget.exactness_grid: All 4 prefix lengths x 4 logical-view counts x 2 batches x 3 fresh seeds, provided memory safety checks pass
execution_budget.timed_primary: batch=1; all prefix/view cases x 3 fresh seeds
execution_budget.timed_secondary: batch=4 same grid if <75% available RAM predicted and observed; label separately
execution_budget.timing_order: randomized paired method order; same tensors and one process
execution_budget.memory_guard: Stop single case if predicted/observed memory >75% container budget; record SKIPPED_OOM_GUARD, never silently omit

mirror_family.primary: static pairwise Givens right rotations with distinct Q/K and V codes; fixed seed; same historical hidden K0,V0
mirror_family.rope: after-RoPE commuting plane-local rotations must match; noncommuting/early hidden change is negative counterexample

exact_controls: Materialized all-View K/V cache and explicit K/V transforms (same attention outputs)
One canonical K/V with current-token Q and output-side transforms (candidate)
Native algebraically absorbed per-View Q/output projections on shared K/V (exact-function non-Mirror control)
Materialize one View on each switch (weak performance baseline, not adoption comparator)
Native hard shared K/V Query-only (different functionality; latency/quality labeled nonequivalent)
negative_cases: identical Q and K orthogonal rotation score gauge
noncommuting RoPE transform without correct correction must NOT pass
MA-253 early-FFN change invalidates downstream K/V
different producer-model/version/token prefix must reject alias
prefix changed with same token-length must reject provenance

exactness_pass.cache_alias: Shared exact same K0,V0 data_ptr/storage objects; do not allocate K separate K/V resident copies
exactness_pass.negative_controls: detect invalid provenance and noncommuting/early-hidden-state case; do not silently claim exactness
exactness_pass.storage: Count canonical KV + resident View codes, indices, allocator padding, workspace; compare to materialized and absorbed native at identical data shapes

runtime_decision: Measure full prefill+256 decode tokens and switching; report median,p90,throughput, RAM peak; no fixed speed PASS from algebra. Mark runtime promising only if throughput >=1.10x fastest exact-functional native on >=2/3 fresh seeds and no storage regression, otherwise no Mirror-specific runtime win.
freeze_integrity: Source and protocol hashes recorded before fresh run; do not tune from fresh; preserve failed cases and opened seeds
limits: Static compatible right-transform orbit by construction, not independent LoRA/model caches
CPU benchmark not a language model or GPU claim
K logical Views still pay per-view attention compute
Initial cache and decoding loops included in measured end-to-end fixture
